fact: Senegal has used the Malaysian operator Iris for card production since 2016, its contract rider ending 21 May 2027, and the government aims to internalise skills in making and managing ID cards and passports using Senegalese firms, per the interior minister.
The Law Committee chair called for greater involvement of national firms and skills in card production and renewal and for national control over citizens' data held by foreign operators.

The director of Senegal's Direction de l'automatisation des fichiers (DAF), Ibrahima Dieng, said national identity-card production resumed after the February 2026 cyberattack because the DAF's identity-card databases were preserved.
APS reports the Direction de l'automatisation des fichiers, a national authority, itself resumed making the national identity cards and enrolment on 1 April 2026.
Senegal's Direction de l'Automatisation des fichiers (DAF) runs national ID card production and its technical services are restoring the system after an incident, per its 5 February 2026 communique.
